title: portfolio-positioning: .harness/config/portfolio-positioning.json
description: The site owner's canonical identity: the single source of truth for everything the skill writes about them. The agent reads this file (the skill has no script). With the file absent, or a required key missing, the agent asks the user instead of guessing; this schema describes a complete file, so the required keys are required here. `$`-prefixed keys are ignored; any other unknown key is reported as a likely typo.

name.description: The full canonical name, exactly as it must appear everywhere (diacritics included). Required: asked for when absent.

shortClaim.description: The role claim, under 10 words, always identical (e.g. "Senior Software Engineer — Data Platforms"). Required: asked for when absent.

extendedClaim.description: A longer line for the hub, the About page and the schema.org `description`. Default: `shortClaim`.

availability.description: The availability status stated as a fact, not a plea (e.g. "Open to senior roles & select contracts · Remote (US/EU)"). Required: asked for when absent.

availabilityUpdated.description: When the availability was last confirmed, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; rendered as "Availability last updated {Month YYYY}" (INV-08). Older than about three months: the agent asks the user to reconfirm. Required: asked for when absent.

anchorStack.description: The 4-8 technologies the owner wants to be hired for; also feeds schema.org `knowsAbout`. Default: [] (the agent asks).

anchorProofs.description: 2-5 verifiable proofs, in order ({proof1}, {proof2}...). A proof with no `artifactUrl` is flagged (INV-03); a missing proof is left as a labeled placeholder, never invented. Default: [] (the agent asks for 2-5).

artifactUrl.description: Where the claim can be verified.

context.description: The owner's role, the scale and the dates.

sameAs.description: External profile URLs, primary first: the first entry is the hub's second exit (INV-06). Default: [] (the agent asks).

publicEmail.description: The address meant for public contact; never a private address found elsewhere. Default: asked once; if the user declines, the hub's exits are the first two `sameAs` entries.

hubPath.description: Path of the hiring hub every page converges on. Default: "/hire".

hiringLanguage.description: Language tag of all hiring-facing copy (INV-07). Default: "en".

siteUrl.description: The site's canonical origin, used for JSON-LD @ids and absolute URLs. Default: autodetected from canonical tags, og:url or the sitemap; asked if none is found.

organizationName.description: The site's organization. Default: autodetected from the site (Organization schema, logo alt text, title suffix); without one, the Organization node and worksFor/founder are omitted.

imageUrl.description: The owner's photo. Default: none (schema.org `image` is omitted and the photo slots stay empty).

resumeUrl.description: The résumé download. Default: none (the hub omits it and the brief says so).

timezone.description: The owner's time zone, as written (e.g. "UTC-5 (US Eastern)"). Default: none (the availability line is used as written).

location.description: Where the owner is based. Default: none (factual prose omits it).

category.description: The category the owner is positioned in (behavioral lever 9). Default: derived from `shortClaim` plus the strongest proof, and confirmed with the user.

writingStructure.description: How long pieces are structured; passed to a content-writing skill. Default: none (that skill's default or a plain structure).

voice.description: The owner's voice for copy. Default: none (clean and direct; first person on personal pages).
